title: Apple Music adapter and Live timeline: #669 round-2 review follow-ups
acceptance: A play() rejection that arrives after the first playing state is reported (apple-music-adapter.ts around line 402) rather than left to liveness.
Seeks queued during a pending play() collapse so only the latest fires when it settles (around line 568).
When a timeline release takes the firedLast skip path, a throttled seek or resume that failed is still retried (LiveMode.tsx around line 692).
Cleanups: queueRequests is merged into queueGenerations, and the unused abandonedAt/expired play fields and pendingPlays are removed or kept only with a stated timing need.
The module-global retired list in runtime.ts (around line 730) is scoped so coordinators and tests do not share it.
The whenIdle() doc in apple-music-adapter.ts (around line 647) matches the code: an expired request fails with the existing Retry wording after 2 s rather than being "superseded".
A decision is recorded on making coordinator seek idempotent, which would remove the throttle firedLast special case and cover other duplicate-commit sources.
Each behavior change has a failing-then-passing test with mock MusicKit; existing runtime supersession tests pass.
nextAction: From the #669 round-2 final review (items 2-8). Start after RF-108 closes, so its owed device check runs on the code it reviewed. Playback code is owner-gated. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #669 on d0e2b52 (merged 0a77110), items 2-8: whenIdle() doc says "superseded" but the code fails with the Retry wording; missed play() rejection after first playing state; seek burst after a pending play() settles; lost retry on the firedLast release path; queueRequests/queueGenerations duplication and dead abandonedAt/expired/pendingPlays; idempotent coordinator seek as a design option; module-global retired list shared across coordinators and tests.
